note: SYNTHETIC. Every email here was written by hand for WO-024 (2026-10-19) to look like the mail a job seeker gets: ATS confirmations, rejections, interview invites, assessments, offers, recruiter replies, and mail that is NOT a status change (job alerts, newsletters, receipts, account mail, cold outreach, look-alike scams). No real person's mail is in it. Company names are used only so sender and subject shapes are realistic; none of these messages was sent by those companies. The labels were written before the classifier (supabase/functions/_shared/career_mail.ts). Fields: from, subject, snippet (Gmail's short preview), date; expect.kind and expect.company (null for kind other). Splits: 'tune' (182; the classifier's rules were adjusted against these), 'tune2' (52; written after round one as a held-out set, scored once, then used for round two), 'holdout' (50; written after round two and never used to change a rule). The holdout number is the honest one.
